dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If you wanna drum up some business, all you gotta do is holler and everyone on the first floor will be able to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Also, you have to come this way to get to the second floor, which pretty much guarantees that everyone attending the expo will notice you guys at some point.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Not bad, huh? Thanks to the spot I saved you, you guys will be drowning in business before you know it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Your point being?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Cross-referencing Jahoda's current facial expression against database... Confirmed. Analysis suggests that Jahoda hopes we will return the favor.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (You bet I do! At least robo-girl gets it.)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay... How do we do that?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Generating proposal... Complete. Jahoda, the next time you visit the workshop, I will reserve the seat closest to the hallway for you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This seat provides priority access to any dessert items delivered from the kitchen. It is also free from window glare and sits at optimal proximity to the teapot.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: By reserving this premium spot for you, I can guarantee you a most enjoyable dessert-sampling experience.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Is this your idea of a fair trade?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? That spot's usually reserved for me. I'd never let you take it if I didn't have my dessert budget to consider.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? Jahoda looks upset...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll level with you. Since I saved you such a great spot for your booth and all, could you possibly lend me some technical support, pleeease?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Technical support"?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This year's expo is way bigger than ever before. Which means there's definitely gonna be more shenanigans going down, too.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Aino, surely you have some kind of contraption that can, like, scare everyone at the expo into compliance, or something? As the manager, I need something I can fall back on in case the you-know-what hits the fan.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmmm... lemme think...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, if things escalated that far, shouldn't you just report it to Nefer instead of trying to deal with it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, yes, technically speaking... But if, for example, it was somehow kinda my fault to begin with, I'd probably be better off solving it myself on the DL...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Remember those three kids? Well, that punk who was harassing them wasn't just some random nobody. He was just the one that got picked to stir things up — there's a whole bunch of people here who aren't happy with the booth situation.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Now obviously, they don't have the guts to pick a fight with the Voynich Guild directly. But apparently, they at least have the guts to harass three kids outside the confines of the expo.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The problem is, I'm not really supposed to get involved with anything that isn't strictly to do with the expo, so the whole thing would kinda be hard to explain to Nef...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Not that I regret what I did. But geez, Jahoda, you sure know how to make life harder for yourself...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, yeah... Sounds like we need to be smart about this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aino, do you think you can help Jahoda out?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Fine. Just this once, I guess I can lend you the Clink-Clank Crisis Control Switch.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Agreed. This option meets Jahoda's requirement for an expo-wide intimidation strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "Clink-Clank Crisis Control Switch"...? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This little guy right here. I made it recently after getting myself into a really sticky situation.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: To activate the switch, you just need to give him three taps on the head. If you do that, there's pretty much nothing in Nod-Krai that you won't be able to handle.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Really? So what actually happens when you activate it?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You'll find out if it comes to it. But I'm only letting you use it once, so you'd better save it for when you really need it.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay, cool. I'll take your word for it.
